restoration_note: Teaching 15 maps the five-fold descent of Divine Truth from the hidden Father through Mother of Life/First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, and Jesus the Radiance, reaching down to Adam and Eve's flesh and returning home in the Last Andrias. The opening enumeration of Greatnesses is highly formulaic and well-restored by editor proposals confirmed against the standard Manichaean schema. The middle judicial section (Living Spirit as judge sent by King of Lights) and the Third Ambassador inspecting craftsmen are heavily damaged but contain enough Coptic anchor points (ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥⲩⲛⲏ, ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ/ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲡⲧⲛⲉ, ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲏ, ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲧⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ) to restore most editorial fills with moderate-to-high confidence. The final section on the hot-stone-in-milk simile is largely intact with only line-end completions needed. The 90 unrestorable gaps are predominantly the medium-to-large lacunae (8+ chars) in chapter 16.33-110 where the manuscript is most damaged, plus several "unknown" gaps without apparatus entries where surrounding context is too fragmented to constrain a fill.
